# Issue #15: feat(formatter): Markdown Problem Documentation and Badge Generation Engine

- **State**: `CLOSED`
- **Labels**: `type: feature`, `area: formatter`
- **URL**: `https://github.com/Inkesk-Dozing/LeetLogger/issues/15`

---

Develop formatting utilities for HTML-to-Markdown description translation, difficulty shields, and documentation generators.



## Objectives

- Strip platform-specific HTML tags and render clean Markdown problem statements.

- Render standardized Shields.io difficulty badges (Easy, Medium, Hard, Basic, School).

- Standardize problem directory structures (`<platform>/<id>-<titleSlug>/`).

- Generate structured individual problem `README.md` files with complexity benchmarks and platform links.

- Generate master repository `README.md` indexing table of all solved problems.



## Tasks

- [x] Build HTML-to-Markdown description cleaner.

- [x] Implement difficulty badge renderer.

- [x] Generate problem README templates and master root README index.
